versionImpact.rationale: This change compatibly adds the optional KFD-5 boundary-pressure diagnostic and deliberately advances the draft KFD-6 autonomous-discovery interface from schemaVersion 1 to 2 because boundaryHypothesis becomes required. The fixed outer KFD package line remains v1.0; major is the honest interface-impact signal.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: README now leads with the civilizational shift, Kungfu path, foundation triad, and product-witness rule, while the complete explanation moves to a non-numbered foundation document without changing decision numbers, axioms, statuses, gates, or registry shape.
registry.json keeps schemaVersion 1 and the existing entry shape, including number, id, slug, title, kind, status, path, and url; slug and path values are stable number coordinates.

KFD-5 schemaVersion 1 additively accepts optional boundaryPressure records, while the draft KFD-6 autonomousDiscoveryLoop interface advances to schemaVersion 2 and requires boundaryHypothesis. The foundation explanation is additively registered as a KFD-1 cross-time surface; the existing KFD-6 version 1 migration remains the major impact.
The existing docs wildcard additively publishes docs/foundation-model.md, and package scripts add one ordered update:evidence entrypoint without removing or renaming any package path or export.

KFD now uses Buildchain v2 floating workflow refs with a consumer-owned buildchain.contract-lock.json, so Buildchain runtime contract drift is checked before heavy build or promotion work while retaining floating-ref upgrade flow.
site/kfd-site.json preserves existing fields while adding the /foundation route, foundationPage projection, futurePicture structure, and explicit first-screen/detail separation.
KFD-5 and KFD-6 usage bodies gain boundary-pressure guidance while their stable /5/usage and /6/usage routes and parent relationships remain unchanged.
KFD declares docs/foundation-model.md as a human, agent, and site-consumer entrypoint and refreshes pre-build plus artifact-side KFD-3 witnesses so Buildchain can audit the split reading path.
KFD-3 collaboration interfaces now declare explicit valueEvidence that binds participant-facing value claims to fact artifacts, evidence artifacts, KFD-2 trust assessments, and residual-risk state.
KFD now ships an explicit machine-bound public KFD-2 release trust claim and passes it into Buildchain release passport generation.

KFD-2 generic trust claims now identify KFD-5 boundary-pressure support and the KFD-6 version 2 boundary-hypothesis requirement while continuing to downgrade KFD-6 because no adopter has proved the draft autonomous capability.

Decision documents now use stable numbered paths under decisions/KFD-N.md, while usage documentation uses docs/KFD-N-usage.md to distinguish authoritative decision text from consumer implementation notes.
KFD now declares its package version through an anchored/manual release manifest so package version state is an explicit release fact rather than an auto-derived Buildchain side effect.

The KFD to site-libkungfu-dev propagation graph now targets the downstream site's actual main branch and documents the exact KFD package surfaces consumed by kfd.libkungfu.dev, without changing the release propagation graph contract.
KFD-1 now defines breaking, additive, none, and unclassifiable as the generic compatibility-impact core, with release versioning as one projection rather than the only interpretation.
standards.json additively registers docs/foundation-model.md as a cross-time explanatory surface, and the KFD-1 witness binds its source and artifact digest from that fact source.

KFD-1 now publishes a machine-readable schema for canonical reader URLs, latest aliases, immutable version artifact URLs, artifact digests, source coordinates, lineage, site consumption, and archive policies that prevent same-version digest drift or destructive deletion of immutable publication prefixes.

summary: KFD v1.0 retains the major interface impact for the deliberate draft KFD-6 schemaVersion 2 migration and additively separates the concise homepage from the complete foundation explanation with KFD-1/2/3 evidence closure.
